 "data": "classDiagram
 class UserController {
 +create(UserRequest) UserResponse
 +delete(String userId)
 +fetch(page, size, sortBy, direction) Page~UserResponse~
 }
 class UserService {
 <<interface>>
 +create(UserRequest) UserResponse
 +findEntityByUsername(String) User
 +fetch(page, size, sortBy, direction) Page~UserResponse~
 +delete(String userId)
 }
 class UserServiceImpl {
 -UserRepository userRepository
 -PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder
 }
 class UserRepository {
 <<interface>>
 +findByUsername(String) Optional~User~
 +findByUserId(String) Optional~User~
 }
 class User {
 +Long id
 +String userId
 +String name
 +String username
 +String password
 +Role role
 +boolean isEnable
 +Timestamp createdAt
 +Timestamp updatedAt
 }
 class Role {
 <<enumeration>>
 ROLE_USER
 ROLE_ADMIN
 }
 class UserAlreadyExists {
 <<exception>>
 }

 UserController --> UserService
 UserService <|.. UserServiceImpl
 UserServiceImpl --> UserRepository
 UserRepository --> User
 User --> Role
 UserServiceImpl ..> UserAlreadyExists : throws",
 "config": null
